A UI screen writes its head, shell and every panel whose reading is at hand first; a panel whose reading is pending is written when it arrives, in document order, so the page is complete without a script and no reader waits for the slowest source to see the rest. capability::readings publishes a typed event when a reading changes (source, input digest, state of the repository), on the event model of ADR 0033; the UI's script holds one subscription per page, with the cursor and gap check the live-stream slice defined, and replaces the panels that name a changed source with the server's rendering of them.
